probing_questions: Which stated if, only-if, unless or equivalent relations connect the selected propositions?
Which conditions are claimed to be necessary, sufficient or both, and what wording supports that direction?
Which qualifications are nested within a condition or restrict the relation to a particular case?
What necessity, possibility or uncertainty belongs to each implication, and does it express logic, causality or a practical rule?
Which counterexamples or limiting cases test a conditional, and what remains untested?

problematique: A conditional-relation inventory with antecedent, consequent, direction, modal force, speaker and stated/reconstructed status; a second table preserves nesting, exceptions and tested counterexamples without turning a condition into a causal claim. Text containing stated or reconstructable implication relations involving selected concepts or propositions.
researcher_question: What qualified implication relations connect the selected concept to other propositions?
